Last month we launched our online book club, with the proposal of reading and discussing *Semmelweis* by L.-F. Céline. Now it’s time to start the discussion! It will be conducted in a mix of Italian and English language in the comment section of [this post](/posts/semmelweis-di-l-f-celine.html).

A similar live discussion will be conducted at the next [Festivaletteratura](https://www.festivaletteratura.it/en) in Mantova, September 2019. The material collected here will be precious. If in the long summer days you don’t know what to make of the lazy afternoon hours, consider helping us editing the discussion into a printable document for later reference…
